subject: maths
title: Odd, even and sharing
summary: Make pairs on a ten frame, spot odd and even, and share onto two plates.

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 picks a pair group of 2. Q2 sees 4 in pairs. Q3 shares 4 onto plates. Q4 sees 6 in pairs. Q5 spots 3 left over. Q6 shares 6. Q7 spots odd 5. Q8 sees 8 in pairs. Q9 shares 8. Q10 orders even numbers.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy pairs small numbers and shares 4, 6 and 8. Medium uses numbers to 10. Hard mixes odd leftover, sharing and reverse thinking. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not just bigger numbers.
